mainCharacter.name: Ruby
mainCharacter.role: Main character; a gentle meadow rescue rover
mainCharacter.color: Compact coral-pink lower body with a creamy white upper cabin and soft gold accents
mainCharacter.bodyShape: Short sturdy rescue rover with rounded fenders, a snug cabin, four strong wheels, and no arms or hands
mainCharacter.face: Large warm brown windshield eyes with soft lashes and a kind smile in the front grille
mainCharacter.wheels: Four dark charcoal tires with cream hubcaps and tiny coral center dots
mainCharacter.accessories: Amber roof light bar, silver side mirrors, and a small cream first-aid kit emblem on each door

Lulu.role: Supporting character; a small lost lamb

Mama Sheep.role: Supporting character; Lulu's mother waiting at the meadow shed

setting.Meadow Hollow: A gentle foggy meadow with soft grass hills, a wooden shed with a yellow porch lantern, clover patches, and a winding dirt path
setting.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded forms, clean single-scene compositions, gentle evening fog colors, and no readable text

style: Warm polished 3D children's animation illustration, bright friendly lighting, soft rounded forms, true 4:3 landscape single continuous scene. NO text, letters, numbers, badges, logos, watermarks, panels, collage, grid, comic layout, contact sheet, or multi-panel. Vehicles have NO arms, hands, or human limbs. Leave the bottom 25-30% of the frame as soft uncluttered ground/space so a narration panel can overlay later; keep all important subjects above the lower quarter.
continuityRules: Ruby keeps the same coral-and-cream color blocking, amber roof lights, brown windshield eyes, four matching wheels, and cream first-aid emblems on every page.
Ruby and every vehicle have no human-like arms or hands.
Lulu remains a fluffy white lamb with gray ear tips, black eyes, pink nose, and sky-blue ribbon collar.
Mama Sheep stays a larger white sheep with gray ear tips and a cream scarf, never wearing Lulu's collar.
Gentle fog appears on Pages 3-10 and clears by Page 12; never scary or pitch-dark.
The wooden meadow shed with yellow porch lantern is the home destination and matches on Pages 4 and 12-15.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, contact sheet, text, badge, logo, or watermark.
